title: Inside the Koreatown Media Lab: FREE Help to Start or Grow Your Business!
description:
Are you a small business owner or thinking about starting a business? Turn your ideas into action with free, one-on-one small business counseling at the Pio Pico–Koreatown Branch Library.

On the second Thursday of each month, experienced counselors from PACE—the Pacific Asian Consortium in Employment—offer free 30-minute consultations for aspiring entrepreneurs and established business owners. Participants can receive personalized guidance on starting or growing a business, financing, permits, licensing, marketing and other operational challenges. Counselors can also provide continued support based on each participant’s needs.

Entrepreneurs can also explore the Koreatown Media Lab, which features modern equipment for designing posters, creating 3D prints, producing business logos and bringing creative projects to life.

These free City resources make professional guidance and business tools more accessible, helping local entrepreneurs succeed while strengthening Los Angeles’ small-business community.

Check the Pio Pico–Koreatown Branch Library calendar for upcoming counseling sessions and workshops.
